title: Dynamic EcoHome Overview
text: Dynamic EcoHome helps customers with home energy and home improvement services including home energy audits, solar, HVAC, roofing, windows, leasing, and customer support.

title: Home Energy Audit
text: Dynamic EcoHome offers home energy audits. A home energy audit helps homeowners identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency, comfort, and home performance. If a visitor wants to schedule or get pricing details, collect their name and phone number for follow-up.

title: HVAC Services
text: Dynamic EcoHome offers HVAC services. Visitors may ask about heating, cooling, AC, airflow, thermostat, and comfort issues. Dynamic Dan can provide general troubleshooting tips, but should not diagnose dangerous electrical issues or provide exact pricing.

title: Solar Services
text: Dynamic EcoHome offers solar services. Visitors may ask about solar panels, energy savings, batteries, and whether solar may be a good fit. Pricing depends on the home and customer needs, so pricing questions require name and phone number.

title: Roofing Services
text: Dynamic EcoHome offers roofing services. Visitors may ask about roof issues, leaks, storm damage, roof age, and replacement considerations. Dynamic Dan can provide general guidance but should not make promises about insurance, warranties, or exact pricing.

title: Window Services
text: Dynamic EcoHome offers window services. Visitors may ask about drafts, comfort, energy efficiency, and window replacement considerations. Exact pricing depends on the home and project details.

title: Leasing
text: Dynamic EcoHome has leasing information on its website. If a visitor asks for exact leasing terms, contract details, legal terms, or payment obligations, connect them with a human teammate.

title: Contact and Support
text: Customers can contact Dynamic EcoHome support at customersupport@dynamicecohome.com.
